title: Comparing Q with K
caption: The reaction quotient Q has the same form as K but uses the current concentrations. ΔG = RT ln(Q/K): if Q < K, ΔG is negative and the reaction moves forward; if Q > K it moves back; at Q = K it is at equilibrium. Here K = 100.
alt: ΔG against log Q at 298 K for K = 100: a straight line crossing zero at log Q = 2.
description: Left of log Q = 2 (Q < K): ΔG negative, forward reaction.
Right (Q > K): ΔG positive, reverse reaction.
